title: Roll for the Server
competitors: Sol's RNG – 2.1B+ visits (per idea evidence, not re-verified) – aura-RNG lane; Country RNG – Robux 'Server Boost' 2x luck for whole server – Fandom wiki, 2026; Mount RNG – +5 luck per friend in server, stacking – roblox.com/games page, 2026; RNG Heroes – timed Server Luck + group luck bonus – rngheroes.org, 2026; Slime RNG – luck stacks with players in server – Gamezebo
demand_check: verified: shared/server luck boosts are already a standard RNG feature (Country RNG, Mount RNG, RNG Heroes, Slime RNG)
red_flags: RNG roll animations can look like gambling if paid rolls are sold directly; keep rolls free and sell luck
why: Shared server luck is already a common feature in several RNG games, and aura RNG is Sol's RNG's lane, so the twist is a feature rather than a new game.
pivot: Use the server luck meter only as a feature inside a collection game with a fresh, non-aura theme (e.g. a current trend object), not as the core pitch

title: Break the Giant Wall
competitors: Block Breakout (Clingco, Idle Breakout-inspired, balls + cards + upgrades) – 4.15M visits, created Jun 26 2026 – Rolimons, Sep 2026; no 100-player co-op brick-breaker found

red_flags: 100 players each firing many physics balls at one wall is a server performance risk (needs client-side ball sim); needs a bot fallback for low-pop servers
why: The solo idle brick-breaker already has one live mid-size occupant, but the shared descending-fortress co-op twist is unoccupied and cheap to build.

competitors: Type or Die (typing party) – 120.26M visits – Rolimons, 2026; Magic Training – cast spells by typing incantations in chat – Fandom wiki; RO-Wizard – typed spell names – Gamezebo; no co-op misspell-backfire tower escape found
